title: S09T04 - Finalize repository documentation, security, and support boundaries
description: Finalize technical documentation, security reporting guidance, support expectations, deprecation policy, and operational boundaries for a release-ready codebase without publishing the repository or changing its license.
acceptanceCriteria: Installation, upgrade, rollback, architecture, security-reporting, troubleshooting, and support-boundary documentation is complete and internally consistent.
Deprecation and compatibility policies identify supported and unsupported technical paths.
No public repository publication or license change is required.
All repository changes are captured in scoped Git checkpoint commits or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health diagnostics are run before closeout.
